provenance.description: Card rows, request rows and Mythic's dispatched input responses (chat_request.context_snapshot) read through Mythic's GraphQL API with operator read credentials over verified HTTPS; channel records and paused HITL interrupts read in place, read-only and WAL-aware, from the deployed runtime DB. Source: .sage_history/2026/11/diagnostics/chat-restoration/20261120-recorded-inputs.json and 20261119-live-attempt-{1,2}.json.
provenance.kind: recorded native supervised approval cards around a Sage restart (chat-restoration live attempts 1 and 2)
provenance.not_a_replay: Mythic transport is a stand-in; the reconciler, resolver, checkpoint reader, validator and lifecycle reconciliation are the real code. The resume itself is exercised by the assembled handler tests with a scripted model (wiring only) and by the line's live check.
provenance.substitutions: Queued rows: the channel record at card time is reconstructed from the recorded record (contract) and the recorded card's echoed approval context, because the shelved build's re-ask later moved the record to a new card. Request rows carry the status they had at on-start (streaming). Saved request state (pending.lifecycle) is code-produced and synthetic in every row; the lifecycle row's event identities and projection keys are the recorded Mythic rows 439/440, its record ids are synthetic. No secrets are present; operator and token identifiers are Mythic row ids.
